description: int16 depth buffer keyed on float-bit-pattern (uint16 sw_depth, sw_depth_key() per pixel in all inner loops + SW_PutPixel)

asi.hypothesis: halve z traffic + replace FPU compare with int compare
asi.mechanism_learning: DOSBox has no cache/bus model: memory WIDTH is free; only INSTRUCTION COUNT matters. FPU compare ~= the extra int ops for key extraction (memcpy+shr), so net +insns per px. Future memory-size or FPU-avoidance ideas must be re-priced as pure instruction-count deltas.
asi.next: attack instruction count directly: flex backface cull (drop ~40% of tri setup work), sky tile quantization, light-fetch trim
